name: Influencing Others
overview: Scripture teaches that influencing others as believers involves living in a way that visibly honors God, causing others to glorify the Father through our good works, as Jesus instructs in Matthew 5:16. This influence may bring opposition and persecution, which believers are called to endure joyfully, following the example of the prophets before them (Matthew 5:12). Furthermore, the seriousness of our influence is underscored by the warning in Matthew 18:6, which highlights the grave responsibility to protect and nurture the faith of others, especially the vulnerable.
